criteria.quote: "Soft and weak, Caterpie eats one hundred leaves daily."
criteria.revision: Open with the unusual Pokédex uncertainty instead: "Why would a soft, weak Caterpie eat 100 leaves a day? The Pokédex says: perhaps it wants to grow up quickly."

criteria.quote: "It devours leaves bigger than its own 0.3-meter body."
criteria.revision: Remove the unsupported measurement and use the researched detail directly: "It can devour leaves bigger than its body right before your eyes."

criteria.quote: "Why would a soft, weak Caterpie eat so much?"
criteria.revision: Hold back the proposed answer until after the prey scene: frame the first half around the unanswered question, then reveal, "The Pokédex offers only a possibility: perhaps it wants to grow up quickly."

criteria.quote: "Soft and weak, Caterpie eats one hundred leaves daily." / "It devours leaves bigger than its own 0.3-meter body."
criteria.revision: Merge the two appetite scenes so they do not feel like consecutive versions of the same fact: "A soft, weak Caterpie eats 100 leaves a day—and can devour leaves bigger than its body." Use the freed scene to show its camouflage in same-colored foliage before the growth reveal.

criteria.quote: "The Pokédex suggests it wants to grow up quickly."
criteria.revision: Make the uncertainty itself the twist: "This is not just hunger. The Pokédex says Caterpie eats 100 leaves a day perhaps because it would like to grow up quickly."

criteria.quote: "A TINY WORM WITH A MASSIVE APPETITE" / "LEAVES BIGGER THAN CATERPIE"
criteria.revision: Replace one appetite-focused beat with a distinct researched behavior, such as: "It crawls into foliage and camouflages itself among leaves the same color as its body."

criteria.quote: "It molts, covers itself with silk, then becomes Metapod and Butterfree."
criteria.revision: Resolve the opening claim more explicitly before showing the evolution chain: "The answer is only 'perhaps'—but Caterpie does grow by molting, then sheds its skin, covers itself with silk, and becomes a cocoon." Then reveal Metapod and Butterfree as the visual endpoint.

criteria.quote: "Metapod or Butterfree: which evolution payoff is better?"
criteria.revision: Ask about the story's actual unresolved claim: "Does Caterpie's 100-leaf appetite sound like evidence it wants to grow quickly—or is the Pokédex's 'perhaps' too uncertain to call that the answer?"
